sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 update: deeper thinking and stronger reasoning (May 28, 2025)
sources.evidence: Dated announcement identifies R1-0528, its unchanged December V3-Base foundation, 685B including 14B MTP, open checkpoint context 128K and launch service context 64K; tools are supported outside thinking.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 model card at published revision
sources.evidence: Exact dated checkpoint card identifies the reasoning update, mathematics/coding evaluations, function calling, MIT licensing, local inference and text-based file/search prompts.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM; 61 main layers and one next-token-prediction layer; 256 routed experts, 8 selected and 1 shared; max_position_embeddings163840; FP8 e4m3 weights with 128x128 scales.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 official repository: model architecture and counts
sources.evidence: V3-Base has nominal671B main parameters and37B active per token, using DeepSeekMoE and multi-head latent attention. R1-0528 announcement explicitly identifies this base, and its config retains these dimensions.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 weight-file documentation
sources.evidence: Explains 61 main Transformer layers, 36.7B main active parameters including embedding/head, shared MTP embeddings/head,11.5B unique MTP weights, and FP32 weight_scale_inv dequantization metadata.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 MIT license
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint repository carries the MIT License with DeepSeek copyright.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 Release
sources.evidence: Release-specific API announcement confirms improved benchmarks, JSON output, function calling and the exact open-weights repository.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for exact R1-0528 checkpoint
sources.evidence: Pinned revision 4236a6a is public and tagged text-generation. Safetensors inventory sums 684531386000 storage elements across BF16,FP8 and FP32; this includes quantization scales and is not adopted as learned-parameter count.

sources.title: R1-0528 final safetensors shard: bounded header inspection
sources.evidence: Only the 8-byte length and 48183-byte JSON header were fetched with validated HTTP 206 ranges. It contains separate FP8 weight/FP32 scale tensors and MTP embedding/head entries; no tensor payload was downloaded.

sources.title: Current DeepSeek API model-version mapping
sources.evidence: Current documentation lists V4.1-Flash-1017 and V4-Pro-0813. These present-day service specifications do not establish R1-0528 endpoint behavior.

name.note: Readable catalog spelling of official DeepSeek-R1-0528; exact May variant.

developer.note: Official DeepSeek organization publishes the card and checkpoint.

family.note: Catalog family key is consistent with the R1 reasoning lineage; it is not the separate Qwen3-8B distillation.

release_date.note: Announcement explicitly dated May 28, 2025; later repository edits do not change release date.

open_weights.note: Public exact-revision checkpoint includes 163 safetensors shards and tokenizer/configuration files.

license.note: License applies to this checkpoint; do not inherit the original V3 model license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal main-model count for the unchanged V3-Base architecture. The launch article reports 685B including 14B MTP, but the weight guide explicitly shares MTP embedding/head parameters; that headline is not a complete unique learned count. Display main scope explicitly.

active_parameters_b.note: Rounded main-model active count per token. Derived applicability is supported by the explicit unchanged V3-Base linkage and matching checkpoint architecture. Weight documentation refines this to 36.7B including embedding/head; 37B excludes additional MTP execution.

architecture.note: Decoder-only Transformer with DeepSeekMoE and MLA: 61 main layers, first 3 dense, then 256 routed experts selecting 8 plus 1 shared expert; one additional MTP module.

context_window.note: Advertised 128K open-checkpoint context, normalized as nominal 128000 consistently with original R1. Configured max_position_embeddings is 163840; launch API/app supported64K. Configuration alone does not override explicit supported context.

modalities.note: Text-generation causal LM with tokenizer input/output. File/search examples inject extracted text; no native vision/audio component is documented in this checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Exact card documents longer thinking and the DeepThink interface; its local instructions no longer require a forced initial think tag.

tool_call.note: Release explicitly supports function calling, with the limitation that calls are not made within thinking.

description.value: May 2025 DeepSeek R1 update with improved mathematics, coding, and reasoning
description.note: Supported as a summary of developer-reported improvements and exact-version benchmark comparisons, not an independent universal performance claim.

patch.notes: 671B and 37B active are nominal main-model counts. The release announcement reports 685B including 14B MTP; the weight guide documents shared MTP embedding/output weights, so that figure is not a unique learned total. FP8 scales are excluded from learned parameters. Advertised open-checkpoint context is 128K; configured positions are 163840 and launch API/app context was 64K. Function calling is supported outside thinking. Current API aliases do not establish this dated checkpoint’s capabilities.

summary: Audited all14fields for May2025 R1-0528. Verified nominal671B main/37B active with explicitscope, MoE, May28release, MIT, tools, reasoning and text. Use advertised128K context rather than163840 configuration ceiling. Do not inflate total with shared MTP weights or FP8 scales.
